title: Labels into one-hot rows
starter:
%ys  = buffer 4 dtype=i32 slot=0
%oh  = buffer 12 dtype=f32 slot=1
%cls = buffer 3 [0 1 2] dtype=i32 slot=2
%y   = load %ys
%yl  = reshape %y [4 1]
%ye  = expand %yl [4 3]
%c   = load %cls
%ce  = expand 0 [4 3]
%q   = cmpeq %ye %ce
%f   = cast %q dtype=f32
%ff  = reshape %f [12]
%st  = store %oh %ff
%oh1 = after %oh %st
hints: The label grid `%ye` is done: each label repeated across its row. The class grid `%ce` should hold `0 1 2` in every row, and right now it is all zeros.
`%c` holds the three classes with shape `[3]`. Make it one row of three with `reshape %c [1 3]`, then repeat that row four times with `expand`.
Replace the `%ce` line with two lines: `%cl = reshape %c [1 3]` and `%ce = expand %cl [4 3]`.
explain: Both grids are 4 by 3. `%ye` repeats each label across its row, and `%ce` repeats `0 1 2` down every row, so `cmpeq` is true in exactly one spot per row: the column whose class equals that row's label. `cast` turns true into 1.0 and false into 0.0. The MNIST program does the same thing with 100 labels and 10 classes.
